scripts.build: pnpm --filter @libitums/ui-lynx build && pnpm --filter @libitums/mobile build && pnpm --filter @libitums/storybook-lynx build
scripts.bundle:host: pnpm build && cp apps/mobile/dist/main.lynx.bundle apps/ios/main.lynx.bundle && mkdir -p apps/ios/Resource/static && rsync -a --delete apps/mobile/dist/static/ apps/ios/Resource/static/
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @libitums/ui-lynx typecheck && pnpm --filter @libitums/mobile typecheck && pnpm --filter @libitums/storybook-lynx typecheck
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @libitums/ui-lynx test:integration && pnpm --filter @libitums/mobile test:integration && pnpm --filter @libitums/storybook-lynx test
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:ui && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:report-policy && pnpm test:bundle-size && pnpm test:ci-wiring
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm size:check && pnpm performance:reports:gate
